name: Mistress Degree
source:
Determined to make the most out of your college years, you decide to take a chance and pursue one of the most beautiful girls in school. But what will you do when you find out she doesn't want a normal relationship?

[From [url=http://thenecromancer.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-73.html]The Matriarchy[/url]]
translation:
你决心充分利用你的大学时光，决定抓住机会追求学校里最漂亮的女孩之一。但是当你发现她不想要正常的关系时你会怎么做？

[来自[url=http://thenecromancer.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-73.html]母系社会[/url]]
